candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool.size=5 with idle=0 and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order 503s, gateway ReadTimeout and 502 checkout responses.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres server-side metrics or logs; pool saturation inferred from client span attributes only.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s preceded by order ReadTimeout, with save_order failing DependencyUnavailable while the postgres pool reports size=5 and idle=0 across all sampled requests. Gateway metrics confirm 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Consistent with db-pool-exhaustion; server-side confirmation still missing.
missing_evidence: Postgres server metrics (active/max connections, wait time) to confirm pool saturation
Order service logs showing pool acquisition timeouts or connection errors
